questions.topic: Why a review uses hedged formulas

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. «It hedges the claim about meeting the deadline.» Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Con «Recognise a hedged formula in a review / No es seguro que softens the claim. / Why a review uses hedged formulas» presente, ¿qué respuesta se desprende de la nota?

options.text: It hedges the claim about meeting the deadline
It states the deadline will certainly be met
It asks the reader about the deadline

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: no es seguro que hedges the claim. On that basis "It hedges the claim about meeting the deadline" is the supported choice. Option D ("It asks the reader about the deadline") fails because it confuses hedging with interrogation; Option B ("It states the deadline will certainly be met") fails because it confuses uncertainty with certainty; Option C ("It cancels the deadline entirely") fails because it confuses hedging with cancellation.
